title: Obsidian Energy Announces Closing of $75 Million Add-On to Our Senior Unsecured Notes
summary: Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – July 22, 2026) – OBSIDIAN ENERGY LTD. (TSX: OBE) (NYSE American: OBE) (“Obsidian Energy“, the “Company“, “we“, “us” or “our“) announces that we have successfully closed the previously announced private placement offering (the “Offering“) of $75.0 million aggregate principal amount to our existing 8.125% senior unsecured notes due December 3, 2030, issued on December 3, 2025 (the “Notes“). The additional Notes were issued at a price of 102.75% of their face value (plus accrued and unpaid interest from and including June 3, 2026 to, but excluding, the date of closing of the Offering) resulting in an…
